commit.subject: LU-20281 tests: skip sanity/27Ke on read-only root
commit.message:
LU-20281 tests: skip sanity/27Ke on read-only root

if a test system uses read-only root, then you can't modify
/etc/passwd, /etc/group -- it's OK to jus skip the test then.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Alex Zhuravlev <bzzz@whamcloud.com>
